caption:
Most owners run every ad through one phone number.

That means nobody can tell which channel produces revenue.

Fix it this week:

1. Free Google Voice number for Google Search ads
2. Second free number for Facebook and Instagram ads
3. Third number for yard signs, wraps, and referral cards

Forward all three to your real office line. The customer notices nothing. Your reporting shows the truth.

Log which number rings when a job closes. In 30 days you have real math instead of a guess.

Kill the channel that never converts. Fund the one that does.

The Ad ROI Calculator turns that math into your next move.
